```{python}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

cups = pd.read_csv("worldcups.csv")
```

## Matches vs. Goals: Plotted

We use @fig-matches-goals-plotted to plot number of matches played at each World Cup with thetotal goals scored. Graphically, we can see that the tournaments with more matches typically have more goals, suggesting a higher chance to score with every additional match played.

```{python}
#| label: fig-matches-goals-plotted
#| fig-cap: "Matches Played vs. Total Goals Scored/World Cup (1930 to 2022)"
#| echo: true

plt.scatter(cups["matches"], cups["goals"])
plt.xlabel("# of matches played")
plt.ylabel("# of total goals scored")
plt.show()
```
